questions.question: Design a clinical documentation copilot serving 10,000 req/s with zero PHI leakage.
rubric: PII/PHI sanitizer in the request path with audit trail before any model call
Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense ANN + cross-encoder rerank, LLM in a private VPC
Deterministic state graph (LangGraph) with human-in-the-loop on low faithfulness
Capacity math: reranker is the bottleneck; shard by clinical specialty

questions.question: Design multi-tenant vector search where tenant A must never see tenant B's chunks.
rubric: Compare namespace filtering vs index-per-tenant vs partitioned clusters
Noisy-neighbor controls: per-tenant rate limits and query cost caps
Fail-safe default: tenant filter applied at storage layer, not client layer
Per-tenant token metering for cost attribution and billing

questions.question: Design real-time fraud scoring at 5,000 TPS with sub-100ms p99 latency.
rubric: Online feature store with precomputed embeddings; no request-time joins to cold storage
Cascade: cheap rules reject obvious cases, model scores the rest
Fallback to deterministic rules if model inference times out
Shadow deploys + PSI monitoring on feature distributions

questions.question: Design semantic product search for a 50M-SKU catalog.
rubric: Two-stage retrieval: ANN recall top-1000, cross-encoder rerank top-100
Embedding refresh cadence vs catalog churn rate
Query understanding layer for typos, brand intent, and price intent
Relevance tension: semantic similarity vs CTR-learned ranking signals

questions.question: Design a delivery ETA prediction system serving 1M routes per day.
rubric: Gradient boosting over traffic, weather, and route-graph features
Quantile loss to publish P50 and P90 ETAs, not point estimates
Segment-level drift monitoring (per region/hour, not global averages)
Fallback to historical medians when upstream features are stale

questions.question: Design a document ingestion pipeline for 1M documents per day.
rubric: Async queue with idempotency keys so retries never double-index
Chunking strategy per document type (contracts vs tickets vs PDFs)
Batch embedding API calls with exponential backoff and cost caps
Deduplication via content hash before spending embedding budget

questions.question: Design a semantic cache that can never serve stale or wrong-tenant answers.
rubric: Cache key: normalized query + tenant ID + model/prompt version
Similarity threshold trade-off: hit rate vs wrong-answer risk
TTL tied to content freshness per knowledge domain
Measure hit rate and p50 latency delta before/after rollout

questions.question: Design evaluation-in-CI for prompt changes to a clinical summarizer.
rubric: Golden set: 200+ clinician-labeled cases covering edge demographics
Faithfulness and relevance gates block merge below threshold
Canary rollout with shadow comparison against production champion
Rollback = revert prompt version; prompts are versioned code

questions.question: Design an AML alert triage copilot for compliance analysts.
rubric: Retrieval over regulations, typologies, and prior case outcomes
Every suggestion must carry citations (reason codes)
Precision-first threshold: analyst review time is the cost driver
Immutable audit log of every generated recommendation

questions.question: Explain RAGAS faithfulness and how you would compute it at production scale.
rubric: Decompose the answer into atomic claims, verify each against retrieved context
LLM-as-judge calibrated against a human-labeled holdout
Sample production traffic (not 100%) to control judge cost
Track faithfulness by segment: tenant, language, doc source

questions.question: A prompt change improved faithfulness 4% but doubled cost. Walk through your decision.
rubric: Marginal quality per dollar; compare against alternative spend (better retrieval)
Segment analysis: which tenants/queries actually need it
Middle path: route only hard queries to the expensive prompt
Decision framed with expected business metric movement

questions.question: How do you attribute LLM cost per tenant in a multi-tenant product?
rubric: Token metering at the gateway, not estimated from app logs
Per-tenant budget alerts before hard caps
Model tier mapped to pricing plan (cheap model for free tier)
Showback first, chargeback once finance trusts the numbers

questions.question: p99 latency tripled after a model upgrade. How do you debug it?
rubric: Compare output token distributions: generation length often drifts
Trace waterfall per stage: retrieval vs rerank vs generation
Immediate mitigation: fallback routing to previous model
Prevent: output token caps, streaming, latency SLO gates in eval

questions.question: Design a regression test suite for prompts.
rubric: Golden set + adversarial set (injections, empty context, off-language)
CI gate with per-metric thresholds; red build blocks merge
Prompts versioned like code with diffs in review
Determinism: temperature 0, fixed seeds where the provider allows

questions.question: When is semantic caching a bad idea?
rubric: Personalized or fast-changing context makes cached answers wrong
High cost of wrong answers (clinical, legal, financial advice)
Low hit-rate workloads pay complexity without savings
Instrument first: measure duplicate-query rate before building

questions.question: Design guardrails without destroying latency.
rubric: Tier by risk: cheap regex/classifier pre-filter on every request
Run independent safety checks in parallel, not serially
Async post-hoc audit for low-risk lanes; sync block only for high-risk
Budget: guardrail budget is part of the p99 SLO, not an afterthought

questions.question: You must migrate a 100M-chunk index to a new embedding model. Plan it.
rubric: Dual-index shadow period; serve from old, measure on new
Batch re-embedding with cost estimate and rate-limit awareness
Recall@k and nDCG evaluated on a fixed query set before cutover
Rollback: keep the old index warm until new one passes canary

questions.question: What do you monitor for a RAG application in production?
rubric: Retrieval quality proxies: citation click-through, empty-retrieval rate
Faithfulness sampled daily against a labeled set
Latency percentiles per pipeline stage, not just end-to-end
Cost per request and query-distribution drift

questions.question: PR-AUC vs ROC-AUC with 0.1% positives: which do you report and why?
rubric: ROC-AUC looks healthy under extreme imbalance (true-positive rate dominates)
PR-AUC evaluates precision/recall where the positive class matters
Baseline PR-AUC equals class prevalence; compare against it
Map to business: fraud loss avoided per alert reviewed

questions.question: A feature shows PSI 0.35 this week. What does it mean and what do you do?
rubric: Severe drift (thresholds: <0.1 stable, 0.1-0.25 moderate, >0.25 severe)
Check upstream data quality before blaming the world
Measure model impact by segment; retrain or drop the feature
Add alerting so this is caught automatically next time

questions.question: How do you use the KS statistic in model monitoring?
rubric: Two-sample test comparing score or feature distributions
Detects shift PSI can miss on heavy tails
Complements per-feature PSI: KS on model scores, PSI on features
Caveat: very sensitive with large samples; effect size matters

questions.question: Why must credit model probabilities be calibrated?
rubric: Expected loss = PD x LGD x EAD; uncalibrated PD corrupts pricing
Isotonic or Platt scaling on a holdout; monitor calibration drift
Calibration is separable from ranking (discrimination)
Regulators expect documented calibration evidence

questions.question: Explain how Isolation Forest isolates anomalies.
rubric: Random recursive partitioning; anomalies isolate in fewer splits
Anomaly score from average path length: shorter = more anomalous
Why it works: anomalies are few and different
Strengths: no distance metric, linear time, weak on local anomalies

questions.question: Cosine similarity vs dot product for recommendations?
rubric: Cosine controls for magnitude: popularity/length bias
Dot product favors high-norm vectors; sometimes that is desired
With L2-normalized embeddings they rank identically
Scale matters: MIPS libraries assume normalized or handle it internally

questions.question: Describe a data leakage bug you have seen and how to prevent the class.
rubric: Classic forms: target-derived features, time-travel joins, global statistics
Prevention: point-in-time feature store, group-aware CV
Symptom: offline metrics stellar, online metrics crater
Add a leakage checklist to model review

questions.question: How do you decide a model retraining cadence?
rubric: Drift-triggered beats calendar when you monitor PSI/KS
Cost of retraining vs cost of degradation, per segment
Champion-challenger: retrain, compare, promote deliberately
Freeze windows for business-critical periods

questions.question: SHAP says a loan was rejected for feature X. What do you tell the customer?
rubric: Distinguish global importance from local (per-decision) attribution
Translate top negative contributions into compliant reason codes
Adverse action notices are a legal requirement, not a courtesy
Never claim causality; SHAP is attribution, not explanation of cause

questions.question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a product manager about launching.
rubric: Frame with data and user impact, not opinions
Propose the smallest reversible test that settles the question
Commit fully once the decision is made; disagree and commit
Outcome with a metric (adoption, incident rate, revenue)

questions.question: Describe a production hallucination incident you owned end to end.
rubric: Triage first: severity, blast radius, containment
Root cause separated: retrieval miss vs model behavior vs prompt
Systemic fix: eval gate in CI so the class cannot recur
Blameless postmortem with tracked action items

questions.question: Tell me about a deadline you were going to miss.
rubric: Raised the signal early with options, not just the problem
Negotiated scope rather than quality
Delivered the negotiated slice with clean observability
What changed in planning afterward

questions.question: Describe a PII near-miss and what you changed because of it.
rubric: Immediate containment: revoke, rotate, purge
Systemic fix: sanitizer in the request path with tests
Blameless postmortem shared with compliance
Follow-up audit to prove the fix class-wide

questions.question: How have you brought a junior engineer to production ownership?
rubric: Graduated ownership: reviews, then features, then on-call shadow
Teaching through design docs, not just code review comments
Measurable outcome: they shipped and operated a service
Honest feedback loops in both directions

questions.question: Tell me about delivering under deeply ambiguous requirements.
rubric: Wrote assumptions down and validated them early
De-risked with a spike before committing the team
Checkpoint reviews replaced big-bang delivery
Final result vs the original ambiguity: what got resolved

questions.question: Describe an outage you caused and how you handled it.
rubric: Fix forward, communicate on a fixed cadence
Own it without deflection; stakeholders remember comms
Postmortem with root cause and tracked preventive actions
What you personally changed in your process

questions.question: Tell me about pushing back on scope you considered unnecessary.
rubric: Cost of complexity quantified (maintenance, latency, risk)
Alternative that met the underlying need cheaper
YAGNI argued with data, not taste
Either outcome: what shipped and what it cost

questions.question: Rebuilding stakeholder trust after a failed ML pilot.
rubric: Honest retrospective: what was promised vs what was possible
Smaller win path with a metric everyone can verify
Weekly visibility on the chosen metric
Trust rebuilt through delivery, not narrative
